text:
Anika (Product): Quick heads-up: were opening a small pilot for the Local Telemetry Broker (LTB) for Private/VPC customers. LTB lets customers buffer, redact, and route anonymized telemetry to a customer-controlled endpoint or to Redwood with residency constraints. Pilot is opt-in (8 customers). Pilot signup + spec: https://intranet.redwood/ltb-pilot :satellite:
Ibrahim (Infra): Tech summary: LTB runs as a sidecar-ish process (customer-controlled) that receives internal metrics/trace bundles, applies redaction policies, and does signed forwarding. Supports two modes: "redirect" (send to customer endpoint) and "harvest" (send to Redwood via mTLS). No model payloads forwarded by default.
Sam (Privacy): Privacy rules for pilot: only hashed identifiers and aggregated counters may be forwarded unless customer opts into finer-grained telemetry. Default retention for pilot-forwarded telemetry = 60 days. We will provide a transparency report per-customer with a signed hash list of forwarded bundles. Internal policy doc: https://intranet.redwood/privacy/ltb :lock:
Rachel (Legal): Note: we need a short amendment to Private support contracts for customers who choose Redwood-harvest mode. Draft clause: customers consent to forwarding of anonymized operational telemetry for the purpose of support and quality monitoring. I'll post redline by Tuesday. Customers wanting zero forwarding must sign an explicit waiver.
Anika (Product): Pilot timeline: week 0 invite -> weeks 1-2 integration + redaction policy tuning -> week 3 verification + audit bundle -> week 4 feedback and GA checklist. We'll provide a reference redaction policy and an example script for SysAdmins.
Ibrahim (Infra): Ops snippet (example redaction config):
```
# sample ltb redaction rules
redact:
  - path: /user.email
    rule: hash
  - path: /request.body
    rule: remove
route:
  mode: redirect
  endpoint: https://customer-telemetry.example.com/ingest
```
CS-bot: Creating pilot tickets for accounts tagged "ltb-interest" in CRM. Assigned CSMs will get onboarding checklist attached.
Sam (Privacy): Action: prepare the per-customer transparency report template and the attestation artifact we will publish for harvested telemetry. Also confirm default retention windows with Compliance.
Rachel (Legal): Action: circulate contract amendment and a short consent form for customers. If Legal objects to harvest wording, flag here by end of week.
Anika (Product): Customer-facing blurb draft: "LTB gives you control over what telemetry leaves your Private/VPC environment. You can route telemetry to your endpoint or opt into Redwood-harvest with residency guarantees. Contact your CSM to enroll or request a waiver." I'll post a one-pager shortly.
Ibrahim (Infra): deploy-bot: LTB-preview v0.1 -> infra-staging at 2071001200
Anika (Product): Policy note: if we GA harvest-mode, we'll require an explicit consent form for any account that forwards telemetry to Redwood. We'll provide a 45-day notice before making consent a gating condition for proactive support features. If you have concerns with the 45-day window or the pilot scope, please reply before EOD Friday. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
